description: This source file defines the DynamoDBGrainStorage class, which implements the IGrainStorage and ILifecycleParticipant interfaces to provide persistence for grain state in Amazon DynamoDB within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initialization, reading, writing, and clearing grain state, handling DynamoDB interactions, and logging.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements Orleans grain storage interface using DynamoDB. Handles table initialization, reading, writing, and clearing grain state with support for optimistic concurrency and serialization.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to the silo lifecycle events for initialization and shutdown.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB table and storage settings asynchronously.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the storage provider (no specific logic implemented).

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the grain state from DynamoDB for a specified grain.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the grain state to DynamoDB, supporting optimistic concurrency.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes the grain state in DynamoDB based on configuration.
